name: SMDJ12CA 12V bidirectional TVS SMC C224064
label: SMDJ12CA
source: JLCPCB and LCSC part records (JLCPCB part page https://jlcpcb.com/partdetail/C224064, LCSC product record https://wmsc.lcsc.com/ftps/wm/product/detail?productCode=C224064), read 2026-11-08 ; datasheet:https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/1d04ec4e5b70068f38a5e05679f27b97.pdf ; height: 2.62 mm maximum (dimension D, 0.103 in), Littelfuse SMDJ series datasheet revised 11/20/15, page 5, Dimensions table (DO-214AB SMC J-Bend) ; temp_min, temp_max: -65 C to +150 C, Littelfuse SMDJ series datasheet revised 11/20/15, page 1, the line 'Operating Temperature Range TJ -65 to 150' (the symbol is the junction temperature; the storage range TSTG -65 to 175 is not used); it is a junction temperature range
notes: Littelfuse. JLCPCB lists -65℃~+150℃ 12V 13.3V 150.8A 19.9V 2uA 3kW Bidirectional IEC 61000-4-2、IEC 61000-4-4. Extended (the part page's label, read 2026-11-08). | LCSC cross-check: model=SMDJ12CA pkg=DO-214AB brand=Littelfuse, Vrwm 12V, VC 19.9V, Ipp 150.8A@10/1000us, Polarity Bidirectional, breakdown 13.3V. // Bidirectional (the datasheet's SMDJ12CA, the 'CA' type of the SMDJ12A). Littelfuse SMDJ series datasheet (revised 11/20/15), table of electrical characteristics, SMDJ12CA in the bi-directional part number column of the SMDJ12A line: reverse stand-off voltage VR 12.0 V, breakdown voltage VBR 13.3 V minimum and 14.70 V maximum at IT = 1 mA, maximum clamping voltage VC 19.9 V at the maximum peak pulse current IPP 150.8 A (10/1000 us waveform), maximum reverse leakage 2 uA at VR. The table's figures hold in either direction. standoff_voltage is VR (VRWM), clamping_voltage the worst case VC at IPP, breakdown_voltage the minimum VBR. Peak pulse power 3000 W (10/1000 us), package DO-214AB (SMC J-bend), the std mapping's SMC. temp_min and temp_max are the datasheet's -65 C to +150 C in kelvin (208.15 K, 423.15 K): Littelfuse SMDJ series datasheet revised 11/20/15, page 1, the line 'Operating Temperature Range TJ -65 to 150' (the symbol is the junction temperature; the storage range TSTG -65 to 175 is not used); it is a junction temperature range (TJ), not an ambient one: the environment check judges the part by it as it stands, the part's own heating above the ambient is not computed, and the storage range is not used (ADR 0099).
